text:
Alex: quick check — rail looks mostly green but a couple of cherries still queued, posting quick async standup.
Maya: which cherries are we talking about? I can take backports if needed.
Alex: PR #4421 (kv-cache fallback) needs a manual backport to release/rail-1.12, tests are green locally but CI is flaky on stress.
Dan: pinged @Jen for review earlier, waiting on LGTM.
Jen: looking now, should be able to approve in ~30m. small nit in a test assertion.
Taylor: FYI canary (us-west) spiked with 504s on long-context runs — timing shows batching thread CPU spike.
Alex: noted. Dan, can you grab canary logs and see if we can temporarily reduce batch_size for that pool?
Dan: pulling logs now. prepping a quick rollback plan if we see systemic failures.
ci-bot: deploy canary started for rail-canary-3 (id: c-9832).
Maya: for the backport do `git checkout release/rail-1.12 && git cherry-pick -x 9b3f2a1 && git push origin release/rail-1.12` then open the PR, I'll run the quick test harness after push.
Alex: main blocker for the cut is CI flakes on stress tests (timeouts around ~600s). if we can mute the flaky test to get the cut, we'll patch properly after.
Jen: LGTM on #4421, left a comment about improving logs; updated and re-ran unit tests.
Taylor: lowered batch_size to 8 on the canary pool and bumped the per-request timeout to 30s, monitoring now.
Dan: rollback ready if error rate > 3%; current error rate 1.1% after change :thumbsup:.
Alex: great. who owns the cherry queue this afternoon? I can take the first two if someone else can own the rest.
Maya: I'll handle backports and the PR queue until 17:00 UTC. @Taylor please keep watching canary for 30m.
ci-bot: CI update — all checks passed for #4450; #4421 checks now passing after Jen's fix.
Alex: perfect. plan: cut train at 18:00 UTC if no new blockers. leaving this thread open for handoffs. thanks all :rocket:
